review_description: We wanted to install a battery with our existing 6.6kw system installed three years ago by My Energy. From initial contact to installation the MyEnergy staff were excellent - promptly responding to my various queries, noting when we would be away, and then a friendly, professional installation. When Tesla stalled on its processes commissioning our battery, MyEnergy could not have been more helpful. Would strongly recommend MyEnergy.

From the time I asked for a quote through to after installation no matter if I had a query I was answered straight away. Found every single person I interacted with were polite, friendly and helpful.  I highly recommend this company.

My Energy were referred to us as a great local solar installer in the south and in an industry inundated we truly feel we won the jackpot. Grant and his team are extremely knowledgeable, efficient and personable in their approach. They took the time to come to our home and discuss the quote they had prepared and go in to depth how solar would work for us and the most suitable system. From initial inquiry, quoting stage, installation to activation we've been highly impressed with their professionalism, quality product and services not to mention price where they came in thousands cheaper than other providers for same system and quality panels. Really pleased we decided to support a local business as we could not have wished for a better experience and outcome.
From the first contact through purchase to installation everything was excellent.

MyEnergy Engineering came highly recommended by two very savvy winery friends here in the Barossa and I could not have had a better experience.Ciaram was extremely helpful, knowledgeable and highly responsive from the time I first contacted his company. I had done a lot of research prior to this and he was very happy to listen to and answer all my questions.The quoting process was thorough.Initially we had a large solar array installed and have just followed up with the installation of a Tesla Powerwall and an Evnex EV Charger.Again, the exceptional advice and help from Ciaram made this a seamless process.They are an extremely well organised business. Each install was done in an efficient, timely manner and Brad who did the installations was courteous, efficient, friendly and tidy!I have no hesitation in recommending these guys because they are clearly leaders in this industry as well as extremely competitive on price.I had been dreading trying to choose a company that I could trust and it turned out to be a fabulous experience - I couldn’t have asked for more!

Fuss free quoting - including tilted panels which a number of companies tried to steer me away from (flat roof). They were very patient while the council approval process dragged on.The one day installation was very professional with the team being very polite and tidy.They left with a great "walk through" of the system and tidy up.I'm pretty wrapped with the outcome. Charged my car 31.6 kWh on the next day after installation - not bad for an Adelaide winter.Evnex S2 EV charger is excellent and follows the inverter output to charge the car with only solar.

The initial contact with the Company representative was informative and he was also very helpful explaining in detail answering our many questions.The installation was completed well and in a timely manner with no issues. The installers were very polite and tidy.I was very particular about the rails not sticking out which I have seen on other houses and we have none of that! Also contact with the office has been very easy and again a great service.A great job all round.

Great customer service, to the point and very efficient. Straight forward process with all connection issues managed appropriately.Installers fantastic, professional and very tidy, would highly recommend this company for solar installation
Very happy with the customer service to date, staff very helpful.

It was a very simple process to use My Energy Engineering for our Solar system. All interaction was either via email or over the phone. We didn't even need to be there on the day it was installed. Ciaram and his team were polite, efficient and provided excellent products for our southern suburbs Adelaide home. The installation was completed in a neat, tidy and timely fashion. And it looks great.The only hiccup we had was removing the temporary limiter after the import/export meter was installed. I'm sure their procedures have been updated since though.Overall, an excellent experience and a company I can highly recommend to anybody looking to install solar panels on their home. Thank you.
I've had this system with as battery for a week now.  It seems to be working as expected.  Let's see how it goes after a couple of years.

A colleague of mine recommended My Energy Engineering SA, and I decided to go with them. In brief, my experience was excellent in all respects! They understood our needs and proposed system variants that implemented different approaches. The quotes were done thoughtfully, not just a quick hack with known solutions. We tried their patience by asking many questions, going back and forth and changing the main direction at the very end, and Grant from My Energy was professional and friendly all the way through. There was no pressure either, just knowledgeable and helpful advice.In terms of cost, the price for the hybrid system we ended up going for was very good (especially taking into account we had an old system that needed to be taken out).In terms of installation, the team of three technicians led by Brad were absolutely great: friendly, clean, careful and accurate, a real pleasure to deal with.Summary: fantastic company, which I would highly recommend to anyone!

We had no problems from the start to finish. All recommended suppliers who quoted were helpful and informative and we learned from each of them. From what we'd learned on solarquotes we had a fair idea what we wanted and the systems quoted were similar or identical, so the choice came down to $/kw. All suppliers were happy to consider the appearance by hiding the conduit and locating the inverter where we wanted it. MyEnergy were friendly and helpful all the way through and their installer was excellent, friendly, quick and clean. He talked us through what they were doing the whole way through including suggesting that the panels would look better if rotated 90 degrees. Up and installed in a day, no hitches, no glitches no mysteries.

My Energy came out to our place prior to any commitment and tailored system to suit our needs.The install looks great and the guys doing it were very professional and got it all done in one day.The communication and support from My Energy has been great.

We got 3 recommended installers from SolarQuotes and asked their reps to come out and look before quoting, as we have a flat roof plus the meter box is in an awkward location. All three responded promptly and quite frankly we probably would have been happy with any of them. However, we appreciated the no-pressure approach of Grant from MyEnergy, plus his technical expertise and patience with our questions. He also recommended we instal a larger system (10kw) than we originally intended (6.6kW), plus a battery, and we're glad he did. His quote, which included tilt frames and individual panel monitoring, was also competitive.To our amazement the majority of the installation (28 panels plus micro-optimisers, tilt frames, inverter plus battery) was completed in one day, with finalisation, coding of inverter, etc. being done the next.  What with three electricians and two apprentices swarming everywhere it was certainly busy! However all the guys were terrific, they got on with the job with good humour and left everything neat and tidy.Grid connection was no problem, but arranging with AGL for the replacement of the old meter with a smart meter caused a few headaches.  Once again MyEnergy came to the rescue, and eventually it was all sorted.We've just had our second monthly electricity bill, which was a credit of $8.86, which is pretty good considering the last month in Adelaide hasn't been that sunny.  We look forward to more credits as summer rolls on.To sum up, we're extremely pleased with the whole overall experience. The people at MyEnergy (including office staff) are unfailingly polite and helpful, professional in their approach, and we are happy to recommend them unreservedly.
Did an incredible job, quick and efficient minimal  waiting time from initial quote to installation. Would definitely recommend.
Punctual and well informed on product. Very few questions as most information provided. Very quick turnaround and no problems with installation

Had a very positive with David and the team at My Solar Energy. David was very responsive to my many questions and adjusting to meet my requirements. They had the best price for what I ultimately decided on. The installation was excellent and all in all a very positive and satisfying experience with the team at My Energy.

I found the whole process dealing with MyEnergy to be smooth and informative. They were the first to contact me and the only company to come out to view the site. The others quoted from their offices.The salesman explained everything very well and answered all of my questions confidently. The installers were polite and efficient and even replaced some broken tiles. They contacted my supplier and arranged the replacement of my meter.I highly recommend MyEnergy for solar installation

I had talked to a few solar companies and even filled out the paper work on one I’d seen on Instagram before I had heard of solar quotes.  I looked into all three which all very friendly and gave good advice.  The one I picked ran thru all about a solar instal in terms I understood and compared other products.  Two weeks later I was out of the other dodgey contract and I had solar on our roof. Great friendly, professional team. Thankyou

Grant and the team at My Energy Engineering were a pleasure to deal from start to finish.Happy to supply multiple quotes to assist me with my decision making.The installation team were very professional and happy to answer all my questions along the way.Follow up support after power meter change over was also much appreciated.Highly recommend.
Yes they organised the lot sales/quotes was over phone and emailThe installation was very good punctual polite and tidyThey organised the grid connect for the next day
The whole process went smoothly, and the installers were thorough, helpful and on task.The manager was always available on phone, and happy to adjust details to our needs.
Everything worked well from initial quoting to final cleanup. Installers were punctual, worked hard without a break despite inclement weather, cleaned up well at finish.

Quoting and installation went fine and were well organised. Had issues with their electrical work and had to call them back to address issues on a number of occasions, including an incorrectly installed consumption meter. They were unwilling to accept responsibility for errors in their electrical work discovered by an aircon technician that traced a fault on the aircon unit to the solar PV electrical work. Unfortunately, this reinforced the reputation solar installers have for poor electrical workmanship. Otherwise happy with the unit.
Easy sales and quoting, explained in detail about the system to be installed. Prompt and professional installation. The entire process from quote to grid connection went smoothly with this company.

Very happy with my solar install with MyEnergy, Lonsdale SA.We are in a rural area and the boys (Rowan and Sam) were punctual and good natured and being an electrician myself  i was very happy with  the quality of the job.Am waiting on the retailer now to install the import export meter.
The sales team were professional, responsive & patient! The installation was effortless & the lads came back once I had internet connected. Highly recommend MyEnergy team.
Really helpful on many ways,friendly and helped me understand about it
My Energy provided the best quote and provided excellent details of what was included. Their installation was quick and efficient. Their customer service was excellent.

Amazing company!! Highly recommend!! Ciaram designed our system perfectly. Gave good quality advice and recommended an amazing system, which is perfect for our needs. The quote and supporting documents were incredibly detailed and stood out from all the competition. The system was installed by Sam and Adam and they took their time to get it perfect. Worked through the poor weather to get it up and the install was done so professionally and it looks amazing. This company really cares for their customers and they even fixed an issue with our existing solar system free of charge. I received quotes from over 10 companies and I am so happy that I selected MyEnergy Engineering, they performed well above my high expectations. Our system is performing well above my expectations! Monitoring is my favourite and the Solar Edge system allows us to track so much!!! If you are confused with all the offerings and different systems, all I can say is trust Ciaram and his team, as you won't be disappointed!! They will install the perfect system for your needs and I'm confident they look after the system for the long run!!! Thank you so much Ciaram, Sam and Adam!!

Good service and communication.I did the light and power calculations and between 3 quotes I received, the quote from MyEnergy was the most accurate one and their offer was the most realistic one.They didn't try to push me to install earlier or later due to any new governmental laws or any other reasons.MyEnergy is near to my place and I was confident I will get a good service which did happen.I had a miscommunication with the contact person but after I called the office everything was resolve as a matter of hours.
Sales man Ciaram Granger very good service and when contacted office person very good and helpful .Installers very polite and well explained when finished.

My Energy Engineering were quick to contact me and provided me with the best detailed quotes. All the information about the products, warranties and a system analysis were provided, and easily found in the information. Other companies either didn't contact me (ie I had to ring them), didn't provide system analysis information or provided product information sheets that were over 6 years old. The sales rep was very helpful with all my questions, and provided quotes on 2 high quality systems that were also the cheapest and on many accounts the best systems of the 4 companies I got quotes from. The installation team did a great job by arriving early, working around the rain, and taking the initiative to replace broken tiles with ones on hand. Was very happy with all the staff I dealt with from My Energy Engineering.
Quoted very quickly and any questions answered. Came out to site to explain everything, worked with us to get system installed as soon as possible.
I left a review on their website. Was very happy with the whole orocess

We are very happy with our solar system. The representative was easy to deal with and was organized.  Would definitely deal with again.  Also thank you to Finn Peacock for finding our installer. Cheers, Chris

Quoting process was fast and efficient. Everything was explained to me in detail.Installation was super fast and the engineers were polite and courteous. They were thoughtful and moved all the broken roof tiles to a place were it would be easier fo rus to swap them in the future.The grid connection is still in process as we have switched the provider. However the solar provider have been in touch with energy provider to request a meter change.

The sales process was prompt and efficientInstallation was very professional. It was punctual and tidy and the installers were all polite.Customer service was excellent. All documentation was provided and grid connection was organised very quickly.

Great customer service, took the time to explain and educate on the entire process. Made the effort to physically inspect property before quoting. Have the best Price in the first quote As opposed to other companies who tried to match the price after they were challenged. Seamless installation, polite and helpful tradesmen. Took the time to help me set up the app on my phone to monitor the system. Would recommend to anyone looking for solar!

After a friend recommended them and I got 4 quotes from others we went with these guys for a 6.6kw system at a fantastic price. First up it's absolutley amazing talking to the head honcho. Just the fact that he answers every time and always makes time for us is so refreshing but makes me think he's not dodging calls from unhappy clients too haha. Straight up and honest. Then the lads came out to install. Friendly, informative, happy to answer any questions. Worked quietly and done in a day. Cleaned up nicely. Made sure we were happy at the end. Couldn't have gone better. All hooked up and working a treat. THANKS for a really terrific experience, felt like I was in good hands the whole way :)

My whole experience with My Energy Engineering was brilliant. Fantastic service/advise, excellent product, easy installation. I've only had the panels on the roof for a few days but they look brilliant and the installation was completed with the highest level of professionalism and care. I could be happier to recommend my Energy Engineering to my family and friends.
We have been extremely pleased with the whole sales and installation process provided My Energy Engineering. Very professional, very prompt, very friendly. Great job!

I had a domestic 6.6KW system installed in June 2020. The whole process from quote to installation took less than 3 weeks. The professionalism and knowledge encountered made it very easy to come to a decision to go ahead. The system presented to us had a brilliant mix of quality and cost saving which was backed up with efficient installation. I followed the recommendations of "Solar Quotes" which started off a process that was very pleasing, educational and stress free..

The service of Energy Engineering leaves nothing to be desired. They discussed the system that would best suit our needs without pressure or disparaging other suppliers. The installation went ahead rapidly from the time of our engaging them. The team were a dream in their effortless and cheerful work, and completed the whole job in the course of a morning. We were given help to connect to the grid, and suggestions about best offers for buy-back from the system.The Inverter brand (not on your list) is Solar edge.

The Salesperson was very polite and explained the product and the process very clearly. This was followed up with all the details in writing. Once I decided to go ahead with the purchase, SEG approval was obtained the same day and the installation took place within a week (due to the pandemic crisis and cancellations).A team of 4 people arrived promptly on the day and the job was completed within 4 hours. The workmanship was excellent and wasnâ€™t rushed and by midday I was monitoring my solar production on my web portal. Even though I had to contact my energy provider to organise my solar connection to the grid, that turned out not to be a drama. I have only had my system up and running for 21 days but by my calculations the expected savings will be significant. Job well done.

Quoting system gave me several options which were well explained and no problems when I came back with more questions before eventually settling for My Energy.Very fast in that I signed the contract on the 3rd April and installation finished 9th April.Grid connection paper work completed and I was advised to follow up with my provider to achieve a quicker connection.

The quoting process was excellent as they visited the site, took a copy of a recent electricity bill and within a few days sent a quote which was to last for 30 days. Upon accepting the quote no payment was required until 7 days after the installation. The installation was excellent as the installers were punctual, polite and advised on how to get connected to the grid.

We felt the sales/quoting process was very informative and allowed time to consider all the options available. There was no pressure applied to make a decision then and there. The installation was very professionally executed by a polite and informative team with everything left neat and tidy at the completion of the install. Customer service was outstanding and all aspects of the project were managed well and within a very efficient time frame. Any follow up questions have been very promptly answered. We would highly recommend this company to our family and friends for a Solar System installation.

My Energy helped me navigate understanding what my home solar needs were. They were extremely helpful providing me with lots of information and treating every question I asked with importance and patience and I had a lot of questions. I would certainly recommend My Energy to anyone thinking about installing solar. I would also like to praise the team who installed the system, they did an amazing job and were extremely professional, punctual and tidy.

Quoting process was easy and pain free! Very helpful sales guy. Installation was quick and the guys that came to do it were really friendly, professional, tidy and punctual. Customer service was great and always happy to answer any question I had before and after installation was complete.

The quote from Ciaram was detailed and without a sales pitch as requested. The price was lower than expected, a pleasant surprise! Follow up questions satisfactorily answered, support with the meter change process appreciated. Communication during the lead up was efficient. The installation was excellent. The guys worked well as team, personable, helpful, easy to get along with and a neat job at the end of the day. There was no sense of rushing to finish before everything worked perfectly, was checked and operation protocols explained. For me, a local company with genuine connection to my community. I am left feeling confident in ongoing support/after sales service if required.

My Energy Engineering Company were fantastic. Ciaram came around to inspect our property, advised us on the best system and answered all our questions. Our system was up and running within two weeks and we are very impressed.Would highly recommend this company
They certainly know what they do. Highly professional and efficient, quick and accommodating.
My Energy was professional throughout the process. Would highly recommend them

Dave and the team made the whole process from Quote to Install so easy. Communication was excellent, they answered all my MANY questions and nothing was too difficult. I would highly recommend MyEnergy to anyone looking to instal solar.

We have ordered a solar system two weeks ago but it is yet to be installed. We were impressed with the salesperson and the quotation process. Cannot comment yet on the installation and grid connection.

I had a full quote and photos of our roof with images of the panels the day after i contacted MyEnergy! Their quote was right on budget and they installed within 10 days. Everyone I dealt with there was professional and friendly. Ciaram Granger was exceptional in his customer service and continued to communicate with me weeks later when we had to organise the Smart Meter.
Sales and quoting good installation punctual, and tidy grid connection all done by them no hassles.
From start to finish this was an easy no pressure process. They helped me with every step without hesitation and the installation went just as smoothly.
Awesome quoting process, system has not been installed yet. Awesome customer so far

After using the spreadsheet from SolarQuotes provided by Finn I went to work and arranged appointments for the three quotes. The spreadsheet indicated that value for money and quality of both the Inverter (Fronius) and Panels (Trina) My Energy came out on top by several hundred dollars on one other quote and $1400 on the third. I emailed Dave at My Energy and within an hour we had arranged an installment day. The two sparkies came around right on time and within 6 hours had everything set up and left NO MESS behind. Brilliant. In the meantime Dave had all the paperwork ready for me to email to Origin Energy New Installations section. As I had a Smart metre already connected, my hook up was completed within 1 day. My Energy are to be congratulated on their professionalism and expertise. Great value for money as well. Dean and Vicki  Woodcroft

The service I received from my energy solar was exactly what I was looking for, I wasn't interested in the sales pitch I wanted a bottom line and what I was getting for my money. Due to the way they went about it I have purchased two separate systems at two separate addresses
All done in one morning, Friendly people who could answer all my questions.

From the moment I contacted these guys, there customer service was excellent.  We are completely off the grid and these guys know there stuff. Quotes given quickly and adapted as required. Site inspection offered and accepted and great advice given based on our home situation. A very professional installation. From first acceptance of quote, system was installed in under two weeks. Thourally recommend these guys.

Wayne Granger is a credit to solar, he is how a sales person should be (I know he owns the company), no heavy sales tactics, no telling me they were the best company, etc. He has been accommodating in my queries, I have rung him after fitting and he has been super helpful,  he has also taken the time to ring me to see how the the system is working and has requested I send him the spreadsheet I have constructed to monitor the system, just to check it is producing what it should be. The two fitters were very clean and tidy, and it was no problem when I wanted the inverter situated in a certain place.I had 5 quotes in total, although MyEnergy were not the cheapest, and not the most expensive, I will use them again when I put solar power in our next property.
